name: Ghosted
source:
You never expected you would move back to Falling Springs after college, but when your biggest crush, Jesse Rodriguez, shows up at your window and asks you on a date to the Falling Springs Fair things seem to be looking up. The only problem? Solving a murder isn't exactly what you had in mind for date number two...

[From in-app]
translation:
你从未想过大学毕业后你会搬回Falling Springs，但当你最喜欢的人Jesse Rodriguez出现在你的窗前并邀请你约会Falling Springs集市时，一切似乎都在好转。唯一的问题是什么？侦破谋杀案并不完全是你第二次约会的目的……

[来自应用程序内]
